name: delta-refs-relay-e2e-direct-not-scan
body: The delta refs scenario exercises FactStore::apply_refs directly with two hoisted worktree ids, not a full apg scan delta record or a real linked-worktree sibling (the sibling id comes from a temp dir outside the repo). Upgrade to an end-to-end one-file rescan on a real worktree if the record-to-relay wiring itself ever needs pinning.
